# T12 synthetic planform ledger

Every numeric JSON value is synthetic, including section slope/zero-lift inputs. None estimates a real airfoil or wing. Geometry inputs are chosen for hand calculations. The runtime theoretical 2*pi slope helper is separately cited, not an inferred value for these stations.
